$comment: Context schema: facts about WHERE/HOW the content will run, supplied by the caller at evaluation time (from the ad server / order system), never extracted by the model. Rules' scope clauses may reference these keys; the compiler is validated against this schema.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the audience, e.g. 'US'.

state.description: US state code the campaign is geo-targeted to (e.g. 'NJ'); null if national or non-US.

channel.description: Delivery channel the creative is booked for.

advertiser_tier.description: Managed accounts have a named account team; self-serve is open signup.
